team.name: Daria
responsibilities: Defines Product Goal and Sprint Goals
Creates and prioritizes the Product Backlog
Has final say on product decisions

team.name: Codex
responsibilities: Turns backlog items into a 'Done' increment
Creates and manages the Sprint Backlog
Adheres to the Definition of Done

stories.name: Story 1: Create Account (5)
stories.description: As a new visitor, I want to create an account.

stories.name: Story 2: User Login (3)
stories.description: As a registered user, I want to log in.

stories.name: Story 3: User Logout (2)
stories.description: As a logged-in user, I want a logout button.

Daily Scrum.purpose: A 15-minute daily planning event for the Developers to inspect progress toward the Sprint Goal and adapt the plan.
Daily Scrum.participants: Required: Codex. Facilitator: Core-Cosmo. Observer: Daria.

Sprint Planning.purpose: Define the Sprint Goal and select the work for the upcoming sprint.
Sprint Planning.frequency: At the beginning of every sprint.

Backlog Refinement.purpose: Clarify and estimate upcoming Product Backlog items.

Sprint Review.purpose: Show the 'Done' increment to stakeholders to gather feedback.
Sprint Review.frequency: At the end of every sprint.

Retrospective.purpose: Reflect on the past sprint and plan improvements.
Retrospective.frequency: At the end of every sprint, after the review.

practices.title: The First Retrospective
practices.content: The first retrospective is crucial. Keep it simple and focus on actionable improvements.

practices.title: Continuous Backlog Refinement
practices.content: Dedicate time each sprint to discuss upcoming work.

practices.title: Avoiding Anti-Patterns
practices.content: Daily Scrum is not a status report. Never ignore the Definition of Done.
